observation: The filing states that the board schedules cybersecurity reviews at least quarterly.
anchor: Cybersecurity reviews by the Board are scheduled to occur at least quarterly

observation: The filing says its enterprise risk management organization facilitates a semiannual risk assessment.
The filing describes an escalation path for incidents assessed as potentially material.
anchor: Any incident assessed as potentially being or potentially becoming material is promptly escalated

observation: The filing assigns cybersecurity risk and incident oversight to the Risk and Compliance Committee.
anchor: The Risk and Compliance Committee has oversight responsibility for risks and incidents relating to cybersecurity threats

observation: The filing says processes identify material cyber risks associated with third-party technologies and systems.
anchor: processes to oversee and identify material risks from cybersecurity threats associated with our use of third-party technology and systems

observation: The filing says the chief security officer leads a centrally coordinated team for cybersecurity and data protection practices.
anchor: unified and centrally-coordinated team, led by our chief security officer
